description: This is the main application class for the Book Project, a Spring Boot application. It includes configuration for a ModelMapper bean and the entry point to run the application.

classes.name: BookProjectApplication
classes.description: Main application class annotated with @SpringBootApplication, responsible for bootstraping the Spring Boot application and providing a configured ModelMapper bean.

methods.name: main
